patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Agorapulse and Meltwater share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Agorapulse and Meltwater share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Agorapulse only if your buying job matches “Social scheduling plus unified inbox and reporting — per-user Standard/Professional/Advanc” rather than Meltwater's shape. Choose Meltwater only if your buying job matches “Enterprise media intelligence and social listening platform — custom modular packaging (St” rather than Agorapulse's shape. Workflow advantage: Agorapulse leans social-media-marketing, content-marketing; Meltwater leans analytics. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Agorapulse and Meltwater share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Agorapulse is Social scheduling plus unified inbox and reporting — per-user Standard/Professional/Advanced with Custom enterprise.; Meltwater is Enterprise media intelligence and social listening platform — custom modular packaging (Starter/Pro/Enterprise/Agency)..
- Company-size focus: Agorapulse (small-business, mid-market) vs Meltwater (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Agorapulse-leaning social-media-marketing, content-marketing vs Meltwater-leaning analytics.
- Researched limits: Agorapulse — Per-user pricing adds up for larger teams; Meltwater — Opaque custom pricing only.

Limitations — Agorapulse: Per-user pricing adds up for larger teams; 10-profile cap on non-Custom plans without add-ons; Meltwater: Opaque custom pricing only; Not a social scheduler or publishing suite.

Poor-fit cases: Agorapulse is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Per-user pricing adds up for larger teams · Meltwater is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Opaque custom pricing only · Avoid Agorapulse if you actually need Meltwater's motion (Enterprise media intelligence and social listening platform — custom modular pac)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
